sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered ship records after ejection: each inferred nose, payload count, clipped ray cells, and visible ray length.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer every ship nose, remove its embedded minority-color particles, eject the same count outward, and clip each ray at the canvas boundary.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Measure the visible post-clipping ray lengths and retain only the stable first maximum while preserving all hulls.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Payload count alone does not determine the visible ray: the nose location and boundary clipping intervene. Selecting the largest original payload before ejection retains a different ship in the qualified curriculum and changes the final grid.

parametric_work.summary: Reviewer-ready two-setting authoring prototype with 2-6 demonstrations, four fixed novel queries, matched setting inputs, a 30x30 stress case, and source-bound protected-Racket evidence. Owner registration, qualification, and acceptance remain pending.

target.summary: Built a complete public-evaluation family for inferring ship noses and ejecting embedded particles, including the faithful all-rays rule and an input-dependent longest-visible-ray setting, with protected-Racket official-pair execution, finite-rival audit, masked exports, and a replayed wrong-order witness.
